slides.headline: 1) PITCH YOUR STARTUP. AN AI INVESTOR FIRES BACK IN REAL TIME
slides.body:
Say: "Be a skeptical seed investor. Stop me the moment you are not convinced and push back hard."

When the questions hit the same spots twice, those are your real gaps.

slides.headline: 2) DESCRIBE AN ANGRY MESSAGE OUT LOUD. GET THE REPLY IN 2 MINUTES
slides.body:
Say: "I am going to describe an angry message. Give me a 3-sentence reply that keeps them, names what went wrong, and sounds like a real person."

Describe it out loud. Done.

slides.headline: $300/HOUR
slides.body: That is what a business coach charges per session for exactly what ChatGPT's voice mode does free, at 2am, in your car, while your problem is still fresh.

slides.headline: 3) PRACTICE SAYING NO WITHOUT LOSING THE CLIENT
slides.body:
Say: "Play a long-time client I need to turn down. I want to keep the relationship. Push back the way they would push back."

Have the conversation out loud. Then make the real call.

slides.headline: 4) TALK THROUGH THE DECISION YOU KEEP AVOIDING
slides.body:
Say: "I have a decision I keep avoiding. Do not let me be vague. Ask me the question I am dodging."

Drive. Talk. Decide.

slides.headline: 5) DEBRIEF YOUR LAST SALES CALL. FIND THE 3 MOMENTS YOU MISSED
slides.body:
Say: "I just got off a sales call. Tell me the three moments where I probably lost ground and what I should have said instead."

Do it in the parking lot. Do not wait.

caption:
Swipe through all 5. ChatGPT's voice mode does things most business owners are still paying coaches and consultants for 🎙

Trick 1 is pitching your startup out loud to a simulated tough investor, Trick 2 is getting a calm word-for-word reply to any angry customer message in under 2 minutes, Trick 3 is practicing saying no to a long-term client without losing them, Trick 4 is talking through a decision you keep avoiding during your commute, Trick 5 is debriefing a sales call the second you hang up and finding the exact moments you lost ground.

Most people type into ChatGPT. The ones using voice mode get something closer to a real thinking partner. The feature is free, built into the app, and takes about 30 seconds to turn on. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.
